title: Shooting probe completed
article: The RCMP have completed their investigation into the death of a man shot by a Mountie near here last June.
The results of the investigation have been turned over to regional Crown counsel for review but the RCMP won't say if charges have been recommended against the officer involved.
Stephen Hanaghan, 45, was killed after a police chase that followed a break-and-enter.
Police said shots were fired after an officer's car was allegedly hit by the suspect vehicle.
